fact: At 25 June 2026 the World Bank reports that EMIS infrastructure has been procured and installed at the Ministry of Education headquarters and in all provinces under ZEEP, and that the consultancy contract for the redesign of the integrated EMIS is expected to be signed by 15 July 2026, with completion and operationalisation expected by May 2027; the project closes in June 2027.
title: Zambia Education Enhancement Project (P158570) Implementation Status & Results Report
